assumptions: provenance is an optional/back-compatible field on GraphEdge — existing edges without it still validate and round-trip
provenance is a string-literal union / zod enum mirroring the existing confidence field's pattern (EXTRACTED | INFERRED | AMBIGUOUS)
AST-explicit structural edges (contains from CodeIngestor's function/class/interface/method/variable extraction) are EXTRACTED
the explicit @req annotation verified_by edge is EXTRACTED

resolver-derived edges are INFERRED: imports (target file id resolved via resolveImportPath), calls (regex name-matching heuristic), and TopologicalLinker module contains (grouped from directory structure)

AMBIGUOUS is defined, exported, and schema-accepted as the reserved value for an origin that can be neither AST-explicit nor resolver-derived; no current ingest site emits it, so it is not hard-coded anywhere
no GraphStore or Serializer changes are required — both round-trip whole edge objects, so provenance flows into existing adapters automatically
scope kept to the graph package per ADR 0104's 'highest-leverage, smallest-surface' framing; adapters consume the field without modification
